ruler apply

Apply ruler configurations to supported AI agents

Options:
      --version          Show version number                           [boolean]
      --help             Show help                                     [boolean]
      --project-root     Project root directory               [string] [default:
  "<LAB>/.lab-runs/f-ruler-package"]
      --agents           Comma-separated list of agent identifiers: agentsmd,
                         aider, amazonqcli, amp, antigravity, augmentcode,
                         claude, cline, codex, copilot, crush, cursor, factory,
                         firebase, firebender, gemini-cli, goose, jetbrains-ai,
                         jules, junie, kilocode, kiro, mistral, opencode,
                         openhands, pi, qwen, roo, trae, warp, windsurf, zed
                                                                        [string]
      --config           Path to TOML configuration file                [string]
      --mcp, --with-mcp  Enable or disable applying MCP server config
                                                       [boolean] [default: true]
      --mcp-overwrite    Replace (not merge) the native MCP config(s)
                                                      [boolean] [default: false]
      --gitignore        Enable/disable automatic .gitignore updates (default:
                         enabled)                                      [boolean]
      --gitignore-local  Write generated ignore entries to .git/info/exclude
                         instead of .gitignore                         [boolean]
  -v, --verbose          Enable verbose logging       [boolean] [default: false]
      --dry-run          Preview changes without writing files
                                                      [boolean] [default: false]
      --local-only       Only search for local .ruler directories, ignore global
                         config                       [boolean] [default: false]
      --nested           Enable nested rule loading from nested .ruler
                         directories (default: from config or disabled)[boolean]
      --backup           Enable/disable creation of .bak backup files (default:
                         from config or enabled)                       [boolean]
      --skills           Enable/disable skills support (experimental, default:
                         enabled)                                      [boolean]
      --subagents        Enable/disable subagents support (experimental,
                         default: disabled)                            [boolean]
